title: Customer Profitability Workbench
subtitle: Business-to-technology blueprint for customer-based Economic Profit (EVA) / RAROC analytics on Teradata FSDM

stakeholders.interest: Bank-wide EVA, product rationalization, capital allocation
IFRS 9 ECL, RWA, concentration risk, stress testing
FTP policy, transfer-priced NII, rate risk isolation
Segment profitability, campaign ROI, relationship strategy
Product NPV, fee income, Islamic vs conventional

useCases.title: Top 20% Customer Profit Concentration
useCases.objective: Identify and protect the small group of customers driving the majority of EVA; design retention and growth programs.
useCases.businessValue: Top 20% generate 82% of EVA; retaining 5% of these customers protects PKR 8–10bn EVA.
useCases.kpiTarget: Increase profitable-customer share from 42% to 48% within 12 months

useCases.title: Branch P&L & Network Optimization
useCases.objective: Compute branch-level revenue, cost and EVA to identify underperforming branches and optimize the network.
useCases.businessValue: Branch cost is PKR 60bn; 10% network rebalancing can save PKR 3–5bn annually.

useCases.title: Product Rationalization & NPV
useCases.objective: Evaluate product-level profitability and rationalize low-margin or value-destroying products.
useCases.businessValue: Term deposits show negative EVA; repricing 20% of TDA book improves EVA by PKR 1–2bn.
useCases.kpiTarget: Improve product portfolio NPV by PKR 2bn

useCases.title: Relationship Manager Incentives
useCases.objective: Align RM incentives with risk-adjusted customer profitability rather than raw volume.
useCases.businessValue: Volume-only incentives misprice risk; EVA-based incentives improve portfolio RAROC by 150–250 bps.

useCases.title: Islamic vs Conventional Profitability
useCases.objective: Separate Islamic P&L, ensure AAOIFI compliance, and optimize Islamic product mix.
useCases.businessValue: Islamic segment has PKR 22bn revenue but lower RAROC (16.1%); optimizing mix adds PKR 1–1.5bn EVA.
useCases.kpiTarget: Improve Islamic segment RAROC from 16.1% to 18%

useCases.title: What-If Pricing & Product Mix
useCases.objective: Simulate impact of rate, spread and fee changes on customer EVA before rollout.
useCases.businessValue: Prevents value-destroying pricing wars; typical uplift of PKR 0.5–1bn per pricing cycle.
useCases.kpiTarget: Price 90% of new bookings through what-if model

useCases.title: Customer Lifetime Value (CLV)
useCases.objective: Augment point-in-time EVA with forward-looking CLV for acquisition and retention decisions.
useCases.businessValue: CLV-informed campaigns improve retention ROI by 30–50%.
useCases.kpiTarget: Deploy CLV scores for top 30% customer base

useCases.title: SBP Regulatory & Basel Reporting
useCases.objective: Automate SBP returns, Basel III capital and IFRS 9 disclosures from the profitability engine.
useCases.businessValue: Reduces regulatory reporting effort by 40%; improves data lineage and auditability.
useCases.kpiTarget: Automate 5 key SBP/Basel reports from star schema
